name: perf-ai
description: Static performance analysis of a codebase with the invoking agent's own model access - no hosted API key. One-shot (/perf-analyze) or staged: /perf-arch, /perf-scope, /perf-plan, /perf-exec, /perf-report - one command per stage, durable Markdown artifacts between stages, re-runnable at any point. Deterministic steps run the bundled pipeline code; reports are identical in structure to the hosted-CLI path.
